Name: Metamorphic Cube - Transmute Your Stuff
Author: ichortower
Description:
[size=3]
[center][size=6][b][u]The Cube[/u][/b][/size][/center]
The Metamorphic Cube is a magical device that can transform items placed within it. Simply open the box, insert a valid combination of items, and press the Transmute button. Your cube will work on the contents until they're all ready; then you open the box and take them out!

Your cube can transmute many things at once (within the limits of its inventory space). While it works, it will pulse, much like other machines. However, it won't show a floating output balloon, like, say, a keg would: once it stops, the new items will simply be inside.

The cube can be pickaxed/axed/hoed in order to unplace it; this will safely eject all of its contents. This will work even if it is transmuting (you will get the untransmuted contents), so it is an effective way to cancel a transmutation.


[center][size=6][b][u]How To Obtain[/u][/b][/size][/center]
After you've made some progress in the game (at least three Community Center rooms or Joja community upgrades), everybody's friend the Wizard will send you a Cube in the mail. You can also get the crafting recipe for it at the Desert Festival, from the egg vendor.


[center][size=6][b][u]Recipes[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Unfortunately, the Wizard won't give you any recipes for the Cube right away, so you'll have to experiment until he sends along the recipe book (after your fourth CC room or Joja upgrade). When you use the book, it will show you all available recipes, one per page.

Keep in mind that the recipe book, too, is magical, and it won't reveal a recipe that isn't available. You should check it from time to time to see if new ones have appeared!


[center][size=6][b][u]I Lost My Cube![/u][/b][/size][/center]
Because there is a crafting recipe for the Cube, you cannot buy it back from the Lost Items shop in the Secret Woods. You'll have to obtain the recipe and craft a new one (or spawn it in, of course).

If you manage to lose the recipe book, that [i]can[/i] be purchased at the Lost Items shop, for the customary 10,000g.


[center][size=6][b][u]Installation[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Along with its dependencies—
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][b][color=#6fa8dc][Red̵a̷c̷ẗ̸̲́ẹ̸̕d̴͍̄]̸͕̇[/color][/b]
[/list]—unzip this mod into your Mods folder, and enjoy, as usual.


[center][size=6][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Not known to conflict with other mods, as it's quite self-contained.

This mod stores its recipes in a data asset, and any mod is free to add its own recipes to the data in order to expand on the Cube's powers. Please forgive me, but I do not have an author guide available at this time.

Everything should be fully functional in multiplayer, even th—[b][color=#6fa8dc][b̵͍̆r̸̅͜e̴͚͗a̸̤͊c̵͙̈h̶̯̄  c̴o̵n̶t̸a̵i̴ned][/color][/b]. Please enjoy it together with your friends.

As always, bug reports are welcome!


[center][size=6][b][u]Other Stuff[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Please feel free to recommend recipes that you would find useful! I'm sure there are some good ones I didn't think of, and I would like to add more in future updates.

[url=https://github.com/ichortower/MetamorphicCube]Source Code[/url]
Releases are also available on GitHub.[/size]
